name: pdk-tap-nextdoor-etl
instr:
We've started running weekly and monthly performance reports on the live v3 API. The CSVs it returned are in /data/reports, named after the report, advertiser and window requested, and /data/advertisers.jsonl is what the tap's advertisers stream emitted for them. With WEEK or MONTH in report.dimensions, the performance_report records from /app have no usable date, the totals don't add up, and the stream is stuck on FULL_TABLE.

These reports should behave like DAY ones: INCREMENTAL on date, date in the key, and each advertiser's bookmark at the latest week or month synced. date is the ISO date of the first day of the week or month the record covers. A sync emits one record per advertiser, week or month, and value of the other dimensions, and each record holds that whole week or month up to end_date, however the run starts or window_days slices it. window_days still caps each report unless a single week or month is longer. Upserting an incremental run's records on the key should leave the same rows as one full run, and bookmarks the tap has already saved must keep working. A week or month value that can't be read should fail the sync with a ValueError that quotes it.

DAY reports must not change, mypy must stay clean on /app/tap_nextdoor, and /app/tests should keep passing apart from the two cases that expect WEEK and MONTH to stay FULL_TABLE. Could you sort this out? There's no network here, and the dev dependencies, requests-mock included, are installed.
